chunks: And whatever was in it from Yaḥyā al-Azraq, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Yaḥyā ibn Ḥassān al-Azraq.

key_terms.أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ: a transmitter in the chain leading to Yaḥyā al-Azraq
key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author's immediate source in this chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct citation through a sanad/isnad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: a major transmitter appearing in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.يَحْيَى الْأَزْرَقِ: the named transmitter whose route of narration is being clarified

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Yaḥyā al-Azraq in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Yaḥyā al-Azraq. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith preservation and evaluation.
